text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
What a disaster... My skin is breaking 
out?! And after I've been keeping up with 
my skincare routine, too!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Not good... This is really bad...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
If your skin is rough, it creates 
friction! And friction will only slow you 
down!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
In other words! The current me cannot be 
called the fastest!!

Calstone Light O was troubled by rough 
skin...
